scope: NFL football knowledge acquisition, normalization, citation, and controlled update
conflict_policy: Prefer authoritative current sources for rules and facts.
Prefer team-locked documents for team terminology and team rules within their declared scope.
Do not merge contradictory claims into one fact; retain both claims and their contexts.
Same-tier unresolved conflicts require human review.
Hypotheses and inferred claims cannot become canonical without review and supporting evidence.
freshness_policy: Rule claims require effective date and retrieval timestamp.
Team documents require season and version context.
Historical claims remain labeled historical and are not silently presented as current.
